name: Skill Foundry
description: Distills reusable procedures from conversations into native Evonic skills with optional approval, enablement, and source-agent assignment.
brief: Review conversations and generate reusable native Evonic knowledge skills.
author: Binsar

variables.name: AUTO_REVIEW_ENABLED
variables.label: Auto Review
variables.description: Review eligible opted-in agent conversations after completed turns.

variables.name: REQUIRE_APPROVAL
variables.label: Require Approval
variables.description: Keep candidates pending until an authenticated user approves them.

variables.name: AUTO_ENABLE_GENERATED_SKILLS
variables.label: Auto-enable Generated Skills
variables.description: Enable a generated skill globally after successful materialization.

variables.name: AUTO_ASSIGN_GENERATED_SKILLS
variables.label: Auto-assign to Source Agent
variables.description: Assign a generated skill to its source agent. Requires auto-enable.

variables.name: MIN_USER_TURNS
variables.label: Minimum User Turns
variables.description: Minimum user messages before a session is eligible for review.

variables.name: REVIEW_EVERY_USER_TURNS
variables.label: Review Every User Turns
variables.description: Minimum additional user messages between reviews.

variables.name: REVIEW_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
variables.label: Review Cooldown (seconds)
variables.description: Minimum time between reviews for one session.

variables.name: TRANSCRIPT_MESSAGE_LIMIT
variables.label: Transcript Message Limit
variables.description: Maximum recent messages sent to the reviewer.

variables.name: REVIEW_MODEL_ID
variables.label: Reviewer Model ID
variables.description: Optional Evonic model ID. Empty uses the source agent model, then the default model.

variables.name: MAX_REVIEW_TOKENS
variables.label: Maximum Review Tokens
variables.description: Maximum output tokens for one review.

agent_settings.name: enabled
agent_settings.label: Skill Foundry Auto-review
agent_settings.description: Opt this agent into automatic conversation review.
